name: chardet-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `chardet`, a universal character encoding detector for Python.
`detect()` and `detect_all()` run bytes through a staged detection pipeline and report an
encoding, a confidence, a language and a MIME type; `UniversalDetector` does the same for
streamed input; the `chardetect` command-line tool wraps it; and the maintainer scripts train its
models, evaluate its accuracy and generate its documentation tables.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the chardet library, its maintainer tooling and its documentation: every module under src/chardet/, the scripts under scripts/ and the build hook hatch_build_cython.py, together with README.md, CONTEXT.md, CLAUDE.md, the documentation pages docs/index.rst, docs/usage.rst, docs/faq.rst, docs/how-it-works.rst, docs/supported-encodings.rst, docs/supported-mime-types.rst, docs/contributing.rst and docs/api/index.rst, the architecture decision records under docs/adr/, and the module, class and function docstrings in that code, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
docstrings, including their examples; code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a
